faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about our learning platform

items.question: Is the content free?
items.answer: We offer both free introductory courses and premium advanced paths. You can audit most courses for free.

items.question: Do I get a certificate?
items.answer: Yes, verified certificates are available upon completion of premium courses and learning paths.

items.question: Can I learn at my own pace?
items.answer: Absolutely. All our content is self-paced so you can learn whenever it fits your schedule.

items.question: Is there support available?
items.answer: Yes, premium learners get access to instructor Q&A and community forums for support.

items.question: Can I learn on mobile devices?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our platform is fully responsive and optimized for smartphones and tablets. You can watch video lessons, read materials, and complete quizzes on any device. Your progress syncs automatically so you can switch between devices seamlessly.

items.question: Are there prerequisites for courses?
items.answer: Most beginner-level courses have no prerequisites. Intermediate and advanced courses clearly list required knowledge or recommended prior courses on their detail pages. Learning paths are designed to guide you progressively from foundational to advanced topics.

items.question: How often is course content updated?
items.answer: Course content is reviewed and updated regularly to reflect industry changes and best practices. Premium courses receive updates at least quarterly. When enrolled, you automatically get access to all updates at no additional cost.

items.question: How does Podacium assess my skill level?
items.answer: When you join, you can review recommended learning paths based on your stated goals and experience. The platform suggests personalized learning paths that match your level, and you can adjust your track at any time.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Get answers to common questions about learning paths

items.question: What's the difference between a learning path and individual courses?
items.answer: Learning paths are structured sequences of courses designed to take you from beginner to expert in a specific field. They provide a guided journey with clear milestones, while individual courses focus on specific skills or topics.

items.question: How long does it take to complete a learning path?
items.answer: Our paths are self-paced. So completion time varies by path complexity, but some paths provide an estimated completion time based on typical learning pace.

items.question: Do I get a certificate for completing a learning path?
items.answer: Yes! Upon completing all required modules in a learning path, you'll receive a verified certificate that you can share on LinkedIn and other professional platforms.

items.question: Can I take courses in a learning path in any order?
items.answer: While you have flexibility, we recommend following the suggested sequence as each course builds upon knowledge from previous ones. Some advanced modules may require prerequisites.

items.question: What happens if I can't finish a learning path?
items.answer: You can pause and resume anytime. Your progress is saved indefinitely. You can also switch between learning paths or focus on individual courses within a path.

items.question: Are there prerequisites for learning paths?
items.answer: Most beginner paths have no prerequisites. Intermediate and advanced paths may require foundational knowledge. Each path clearly lists any requirements before you enroll.

items.question: How does Podacium recommend learning paths for my career goals?
items.answer: Podacium recommends learning paths based on your learning history and career interests. Recommendations adapt as you complete modules, and you can adjust your path or override suggestions at any time.

items.question: Can I preview learning path content before enrolling?
items.answer: Each learning path has a detailed overview page listing all modules, learning objectives, and estimated duration. You can review the full curriculum before enrolling to evaluate whether the path matches your goals.
